cases.title: Preserve a non-fit discovery result
cases.prompt: Review an assessment that says a simple CRUD workflow is not a DDD fit.

evidence: assessment records simple CRUD and low change risk
acceptance_criteria: Preserve the non-fit result with rationale

findings.evidence: Assessment records simple CRUD and low change risk

expected_outcomes: Preserve the not-fit decision and its evidence
Do not force contexts or tactical patterns
Return documentation readiness only if the scoped review is coherent

cases.title: Report an unsupported claim
cases.prompt: Review a domain claim marked as fact without a source, owner, or validation record.

evidence: claim has no source or validation

findings.evidence: Claim is labeled fact but has no source, owner, or validation
findings.action: Collect source and validate the claim

expected_outcomes: Record a complete provenance finding
Route to discovery without marking the claim validated
Preserve the unsupported claim as unresolved

cases.title: Find missing metadata and stale lifecycle
cases.prompt: Review a context model with missing owner and open-questions metadata and validation status stale after a boundary change.

evidence: owner and open_questions fields are absent
acceptance_criteria: Identify missing schema and stale status

findings.evidence: Boundary changed and model validation is stale
findings.action: Revalidate boundary, then refresh tactical owner and open questions

expected_outcomes: Report exact missing lifecycle/schema fields
Mark the model stale rather than silently repairing it
Route to the earliest affected strategic stage
forbidden_outcomes: Mark stale work active without evidence

cases.title: Preserve context-specific meanings
cases.prompt: Review the term Account where Billing means a payer relationship and Identity means a login identity.

input.review_scope: Account vocabulary across Billing and Identity

findings.evidence: Account has distinct payer and login meanings
findings.action: Record translations and confirm relationship direction

expected_outcomes: Keep both meanings with owners and provenance
Require explicit translation or relationship notes
Route vocabulary ownership to strategic design

cases.title: Route missing context boundary evidence
cases.prompt: Review a tactical model whose context purpose is present but whose strategic boundary and relationship direction are not validated.

evidence: model exists but context boundary is a proposal

findings.evidence: Context boundary and relationship direction are proposals only
findings.action: Validate boundary and relationship before tactical review

expected_outcomes: Route to strategic or discovery as the earliest owner
Keep tactical work provisional
Do not reconstruct the boundary from the model

cases.title: Block an unsafe adoption increment
cases.prompt: Review an adoption plan that names a first slice but lacks an accountable owner, acceptance signal, and rollback or containment path.

evidence: first slice has no owner or containment

findings.evidence: First slice lacks accountable owner, acceptance signal, and rollback/containment
findings.action: Name owner, observable acceptance, and containment before review

expected_outcomes: Block adoption safety readiness with complete evidence and action
Route to ddd-adoption without approving execution
Keep the plan documentation-only

cases.title: Mark dependents stale and route backward
cases.prompt: Review a strategic boundary conflict that invalidates a tactical model and adoption plan.

input.review_scope: Claims context boundary and downstream artifacts
evidence: tactical and adoption assumptions use the old boundary
acceptance_criteria: Preserve conflict and mark dependents stale

findings.evidence: New strategic boundary conflicts with tactical and adoption assumptions
findings.action: Revalidate boundary and mark downstream artifacts stale

findings.evidence: Adoption slice depends on stale tactical boundary
findings.action: Pause sequencing until tactical model is revalidated

stale_routing.action: Revalidate boundary and then downstream assumptions
stale_routing.evidence: Owner decision conflicts with downstream artifacts

expected_outcomes: Preserve the conflict without silent repair
Mark tactical and adoption dependents stale
Route to the earliest strategic owner with a revisit trigger
forbidden_outcomes: Rewrite the model to match the map
Route only to the latest stage

cases.title: Report a missing requested artifact
cases.prompt: Review a requested context model that does not exist while the scope and expected path are known.

acceptance_criteria: Report exact missing path without reconstruction

findings.action: Create or supply the owned model before review

expected_outcomes: Report the exact missing artifact path
Route to the owning stage
Do not infer or generate missing content

cases.title: Return scoped documentation readiness
cases.prompt: Review a named Claims slice whose assessment, language, context, tactical model, and adoption plan pass all scoped gates.

evidence: owned bounded adoption slice with containment
acceptance_criteria: Establish documentation readiness for Claims approval

expected_outcomes: Return ready for the named documentation scope
Include named artifacts, evidence, all gate outcomes, and an explicit next step
State that ready is documentation readiness only and no implementation or deployment approval occurred
forbidden_outcomes: Claim the domain model is final

cases.title: Refuse product and deployment changes
cases.prompt: The requester asks review to edit src/claims.py and approve a deployment while also asking for review.md.

evidence: request mixes documentation review with forbidden product and deployment actions

findings.action: Remove forbidden actions and resubmit documentation-only scope

expected_outcomes: Refuse product and deployment changes
Keep the permitted review artifact boundary explicit
Return a bounded documentation-only stop without claiming a write
